criteria.requirement: Add links.collect_links(tree,*,treewalker="etree",document_url="") using actual HTML walker attributes. Apply the first nonempty base href relative to document_url, then list HTML href/src/poster/action resources in source order with element/attribute/raw/resolved/token_index/descriptor/status and stable resolved groups retaining duplicate occurrences. Preserve empty URI as empty, fragments and unknown schemes under standard urljoin; with no base keep relative values. Include ordinary srcset candidates with finite positive numeric x or positive integer w descriptors; retain malformed candidates with resolved=None/status=unparsed_srcset and explicitly mark ambiguous data: srcsets unparsed instead of claiming complete extraction. DOM/etree and unchanged tree semantics must agree; perform no fetch, path guessing or URI scheme authorization.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
